hypotheses.statement: solc and solang agree on reads, writes, and deletes of tightly packed small-value storage slots (uint8/bool/uint32 sharing one EVM slot vs SCALE-encoded individual trie entries), producing identical snapshots, event payloads, and storage entry counts under a count-mode oracle.

evidence.note: setPacked with max values (y=0xFFFFFFFF, z=255) followed by delete z produced matching snapshots, events, and storage counts on both backends.

hypotheses.next_probe: A probe that deletes the middle variable (flag or y) of the packed group while setting its neighbors to nonzero values in the same transaction, then snapshots — this tests whether clearing one packed field corrupts neighbors on either toolchain.

hypotheses.statement: solc and solang agree on bytes/string storage when crossing the EVM short/long threshold (<=31 bytes inline vs length*2+1 at the slot) — length transitions from 3 bytes to 40 bytes yield identical data.length/text.length reporting and storage counts.

evidence.note: Transitioning text 3->40 chars and data 3->40 bytes (crossing the 31-byte EVM inline threshold) produced identical length reports and storage entry counts.

hypotheses.next_probe: Probe setBlob with strings/bytes of exactly 31 and 32 bytes (boundary case), plus a shrink from >31 back to <31, checking snapshot lengths and storage count after each step.
